; Retrom authored fixture: custom dialogue click routine and four stable waits.
*define
windowback
defaultspeed 0,0,0
textgosub *dialogue
game
*start
bg "background.bmp",1
setwindow 16,340,40,5,20,20,0,2,0,1,1,"#000000",0,320,639,479
mov %0,7
; UTF-8 multibyte text uses the native inline textgosub lexer. One, two, three
; and four accented characters give visibly distinct suspended continuations.
é@éé@ééé@éééé\
mov %0,8
; A native lrclick sets SKIP_TO_EOL. Finish an ordinary short text line so
; processEOT clears that mode before the actual timed typewriter transition.
é
textclear
textspeed 100
éééééééééééééééééééééééééééééééééééééééé@
goto *start
*dialogue
erasetextwindow 0
lrclick
getret %1
texec
saveon
return
